content:
Hillary Clinton delivered a sharp fact check about Donald Trump after the president took a swipe at her home while defending his gold-heavy White House makeover.

Trump claimed to know Clinton’s house “very well” during an Oval Office event last week, prompting the former secretary of state to publicly dispute his assertion and then immediately mock his social media style.

The exchange began Thursday when Trump was asked about criticism of his White House renovations, while signing a proclamation that he said would turn the Oval Office and Cabinet Room into a national monument.

Told that Clinton had slammed his redecoration efforts, Trump said: “She did? I don’t like her house either. I know her house very well.”

“Look, the Oval Office is a place of victory. It’s a place of prestige,” he added.

Clinton this summer said the White House had been “so tackyed up” under Trump, describing it as a reflection of “his narcissistic personality and his need to feel important, including sticking gold embellishments all over the walls of the Oval Office.”

But Clinton disputed Trump’s new comment about her home in a post on X, sharing a screenshot of an article reporting his remarks.

“He’s never been in my house,” she wrote.

“He’ll never be in my house,” she added.

She signed off mockingly, parroting Trump’s social media style: “Thank you for your attention to the matter of my house.”

Trump and the Clintons were once on friendly terms, with former President Bill and former first lady Hillary attending his 2005 wedding celebrations to now-first lady Melania Trump. Their relationship has since soured, particularly following their bitter election battle.
